verdicts.evidence: plan.md's Tasks section maps every listed issue to a task (T1:#3,#10,#11; T2:#5,#6,#12,#15-partial; T3:#4,#2; T4:#1; T5:#14; T6:#13; T7:#15-remainder; T8:#16), and its 'G12, and where #9's closure happened' section explains #9 is a closure rather than a fix, matching the spec's own arithmetic rather than dropping it silently.

plan.md's Approach section states tasks are grouped 'by file rather than by issue, exactly as the spec lays them out' and that waves are computed from `depends_on` so file sets without an ordering edge are disjoint, 'which is takt's own plan-disjoint rule'.

plan.index.json task 1 description item (1) has cmd_version.go detect that --expect was given and route a literal-empty value through the existing versionless refusal instead of exiting 0, with verify test `TestVersionExpectEmptyFailsTheHandshake`.

plan.index.json task 1 item (2) collapses `manifestFailure` + duplicate `ManifestMatches` calls into one judging helper, with an acceptance verify grepping for exactly two `ManifestMatches(` occurrences in cmd_version.go.

plan.index.json task 1 item (3) gives `--expect` its own subject noun ('does not match skill version'/'update the skill') while `--expect-manifest` keeps 'plugin', verified by `grep -q 'does not match skill version' internal/cli/cmd_version.go`.

plan.index.json task 2 part (C) makes `excludeLogsDir`'s failure stop failing both `init` (no rollback) and `next` (`acquireLock`), reporting it via the warnings key instead — 'init and next exit 0, ... the warning names info/exclude'.

plan.index.json task 2 part (B) adds a gitignore-pattern escaper to internal/gitx/git.go applied to the repo-relative bundle path in `excludeLogsDir`, keeping `EnsureExclude`'s verbatim contract, with tests for a glob-bearing and a backslash-bearing `--dir`.

plan.index.json task 2 part (A) adds `bundle.WriteFileAtomic` beside `WriteJSONAtomic` and switches the brief/slice-diff writers in cmd_next.go (plus launch.go and cmd_init.go) to it, verified by grepping that `os.WriteFile` no longer appears in cmd_next.go.

plan.index.json task 3 gates the event switch so an event only appends when `outcome` is `stolen`/`forced`, and conditions the generated-over-generated exemption on `--force` not being passed, implementing the spec's log-it ruling with tests like `TestNextExplicitForceOverAGeneratedHolderAppendsLockTaken`.

plan.md's 'G12, and where #9's closure happened' section states #9 'is closed as part of this run's bookkeeping, not implemented' and that 'no task performs or re-performs it, because closing a GitHub issue is outward-facing' — matching the spec's already-fixed finding rather than dropping the issue unaddressed.

plan.index.json task 4 rewrites internal/brief/templates/planner.md to wrap `.Problems` in `{{quote .Token "rejection" (join .Problems "\n")}}` and extends `TestRejectionReasonsAreQuotedBackOnTheRetry` to the planner.

plan.index.json task 5 changes `RenderCopilotAgent`'s signature to receive the source path from hostgen's `--root`-aware caller and unifies both error messages, with a new test asserting a non-'.' `--root` names the real source path.

plan.index.json task 6 adds a `--print` mode to setversion and changes Taskfile.yml's `build` to pass `-ldflags` with the parsed version, verified by `./takt version` matching the manifest version and not printing `0.0.0-dev`.

plan.index.json task 7 adds `TestAcquireStealBoundaryAndSelfStale`, `TestPromptInvariantsReadTheSameOnEveryHost`, and `TestQuotedScalarProblemBackslashRuns`, while task 2 part (D) adds the writeLogsIgnore already-present case beside `TestNextRestoresADeletedLogsIgnore` — covering all four #15 sub-gaps.
plan.md's Class justifications and Assumptions carry the user-confirmed rulings ('Report it in the command's JSON, exit 0' for #16; 'Log it' for #4) and task 8/task 3 implement them respectively.

plan.index.json task 3 rewrites §4.6 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-takt-design.md 'to state all three parts' per the #4 ruling, verified by `grep -q 'explicitly forced' docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-takt-design.md`.

No task in plan.index.json touches #34 or the diagnostics/retro/review-layer cluster files; plan.md's task list is confined to cmd_version.go, the init/next write path, cmd_next.go, planner.md, hostgen, Taskfile.yml/setversion, test files and facts.go/cmd_record.go/record_reviewer.go only.

plan.index.json's wave-2 tasks (id 3 and id 8) both list `go test -race ./...` and `golangci-lint run ./...` in their verify arrays, and plan.md states 'what actually proves G13 is takt verify at finish: it runs the union of every task's verify commands at HEAD ... after the last wave has committed'.
